title: Elux Legend Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum from Elux Legend Nic Salts is a sweet and juicy candy flavour that will transport you to carefree summer days. This irresistible e-liquid offers the perfect combination of juicy strawberries, refreshing watermelon, and sweet bubblegum, providing a smooth and satisfying throat hit. Experience the iconic flavours of Elux disposables in a convenient and portable 10ml bottle with our Elux Legend Nic Salts collection. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, our Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, while providing rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Our Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength , making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate and satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Each flavour is carefully crafted using premium ingredients, ensuring a clean and authentic taste that will tantalize your taste buds with each puff. Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids provide a smoother and more satisfying hit than traditional freebase nicotine as nicotine salts are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, allowing for a quick and efficient nicotine delivery without any harshness or throat irritation. The Elux Legend Nic Salts are designed for use with pod systems and other low-wattage devices, providing a more concentrated and flavourful vaping experience. They are the perfect choice for vapers seeking a high-quality, smooth, and satisfying nicotine hit coupled with incredible flavours. Try the Elux Legend Nic Salts line today and experience the next level of vaping satisfaction.
